name: go9_fresh_correct
hypothesis: Training from scratch with correct dirichlet_alpha=0.03 and c_puct=1.5 gives better results than warm-starting from Fix D (which was trained with broken alpha=0.12 and conservative c_puct=1.0). The model may have learned bad habits from insufficient exploration.
success_criteria: >80% vs random by iter 150, >95% by iter 300. Kill early if loss plateaus for 100 iters.
notes: No warm start. Correct alpha=0.03, c_puct=1.5, window buffer, FPU 0.2/0.1. Compare directly to scale500 (warm-start). If this beats scale500, it means Fix D's habits hurt more than the warm-start helped.
